confidence_notes: Food and drink prices come from aggregated cost-of-living web results seen in November 2026. Numbeo gave about EUR 15 for an inexpensive meal, EUR 3.96 for a cappuccino, EUR 6 for a 0.5 L draft beer and EUR 80 for a mid-range meal for two. Other aggregators gave similar figures. Euros were converted at about 1.10 USD per EUR, a cross-rate worked out from RBA AUD/USD and AUD/EUR figures reported by a third-party site. The cocktail price is less certain: crowd-sourced data from few price points and a nightlife guide range of EUR 8-14 put it at about EUR 11. Wine by the glass is also less certain at about EUR 7. A bar guide says glasses start around EUR 6 in wine bars, and I checked this against the local beer price. Accommodation figures are my own estimates from general knowledge for July, which is peak summer season with heavy cruise and Nordic tourist demand. I did not check live listings, so these are the least certain anchors. Prices may change between November 2026 and July 2026 is past, so the figures reflect current typical levels rather than a forward forecast.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tallinn costs a bit less than Helsinki and Western European capitals and a little more than Riga and Vilnius. For accommodation, I benchmarked against Baltic and Central European capitals with strong summer tourism, such as Riga and Prague.
